schemaNote: GPIR Trusted Source Registry. A hand-maintained allowlist of organizations whose official domain(s) GPIR has verified. Used by assets/js/trust-engine.js to confirm that an intelligence record's cited source URL resolves to the domain of the organization it claims to be. This is NOT a connected threat-intelligence or malware-scanning service. An organization's absence means GPIR has not yet verified its domain. A refreshEndpoint is opt-in, manually verified and machine-readable. Discovery creates proposal candidates; only active VERIFIED_OFFICIAL Tier-1 primary sources may enter the separate deterministic validation gate, whose changes remain branch and pull-request controlled.
